bugs_found.title: config set accepts arbitrary unknown keys without validation
bugs_found.description: wikigen config set accepts any key name including completely invalid ones (e.g., totally_fake_key). The command exits 0 with a success message and writes the unknown key to config.json.
bugs_found.expected: Command should validate the key against a list of known configuration fields and return a non-zero exit code with an error message for unknown keys.
bugs_found.actual: Exit code 0, output: "✓ Updated totally_fake_key to foobar", and key was written to /root/.config/wikigen/config.json as {"totally_fake_key": "foobar"}.

bugs_found.title: mcp subcommand produces no output and no error
bugs_found.description: Running "wikigen mcp --help" or "wikigen mcp" produces zero bytes of output and exits with code 0. The mcp subcommand is not documented in the main --help. It silently does nothing.
bugs_found.expected: Either: (a) mcp subcommand is documented and provides help/usage text when --help is passed, or (b) the subcommand is not recognized and returns an error with exit code 1.
bugs_found.actual: Exit code 0, zero bytes of output for both "wikigen mcp" and "wikigen mcp --help".

bugs_found.title: Empty directory error message is generic and not informative
bugs_found.description: When run against an empty directory, wikigen reports "Failed to fetch files" which is a generic catch-all error rather than a specific message indicating no matching files were found.
bugs_found.expected: A more descriptive message such as "No files found matching include patterns in the specified directory" to help users diagnose the issue.
bugs_found.actual: Error: "Failed to fetch files / Please check your configuration and try again." with exit code 1.
